images.alt: 4th August 2026 Hourly temperature at Kelburn. A line graph with time on the x axis and temperature on the y axis. It shows temperatures peaking at 1am, then slowly decreasing through the morning, then picking up slightly towards midday. At 2pm temperatures suddenly dive to 1.8 degrees and then wobble slowly upwards through the rest of the day

post.text:
🌨️ Here's an anatomy of the snow flurries which caused such excitement in Wellington yesterday

📉 The high for the day was 8.9°C at 1am.  The strengthening southerly pushed temperatures down through the morning, until the sun started to get a bit of strength and start increasing the temperature.

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
